failed_hard_gates.evidence: At both thumbnail and native scales, the two diagonal straps visibly cross as an X instead of merging into one central converged path between the shoulder blades; partial intersection is not convergence.
Native pixels show crossed diagonal paths and a broad triangular back opening below the intersection, with no single narrow Y-shaped central yoke continuing down the upper spine.
The lower bra band is visible at both scales, but a single central yoke is absent, so continuous central-yoke attachment into the lower band is not proven.
Native pixels clearly show an X-shaped strap crossing on the upper back, which is the explicit crossback substitute this gate requires the topology to exclude.
